scripts.e2e:tabs: SPINDLE_HOME=1 vite build --outDir dist-home && E2E_DIST=$PWD/dist-home node e2e/tabs.mjs
scripts.e2e:slice-page: SPINDLE_SLICE_PAGE=1 vite build --outDir dist-slice && E2E_DIST=$PWD/dist-slice node e2e/slice-page.mjs
scripts.e2e:home: SPINDLE_HOME=1 vite build --outDir dist-home && E2E_DIST=$PWD/dist-home node e2e/home.mjs
scripts.e2e:offline: SPINDLE_OFFLINE=1 vite build --outDir dist-offline && E2E_DIST=$PWD/dist-offline node e2e/offline.mjs
scripts.e2e:engines: s=0; for t in undo sketch sketch-tool sketch-session sketch-pixels hidden-edges extrude face-sketch face-edges projection projection-hunt face-hunt timeline leave-save sketch-shell sketch-constraints point-drag sketch-dimensions sketch-construction; do timeout 600 node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings e2e/$t.mjs || { echo "$t failed or ran past 10 minutes"; s=1; }; done; exit $s
